gaps.sentence: He boasted ___ winning the race, but nobody believed him.
gaps.explanation: boast ABOUT/OF something. 'About' is the most common.

gaps.sentence: Viewers were shocked ___ the violence in the film.
Over two hundred athletes participated ___ the marathon.
gaps.explanation: participate IN an event (also: take part in).

gaps.sentence: Critics attacked the film ___ its slow pace.
She has a good relationship ___ her students.
gaps.explanation: a relationship WITH somebody (BETWEEN two parties).

gaps.sentence: Don't worry ___ the exam — you're well prepared.
He's not very friendly ___ his new colleagues.
gaps.explanation: friendly WITH somebody = on good terms; a friendly person is friendly TO others.

gaps.sentence: The film had an immediate effect ___ audiences.
